name: PNETInstantLaunchpad

methods.name: initialize
methods.desc: Fund base/PNET MBR and a one-ALGO safety reserve once.

methods.name: create_asset
methods.desc: Create an immutable six-decimal ASA and retain its entire supply.

methods.name: swap_pnet
methods.desc: Atomically swap exactly one ALGO and escrow measured PNET output.

methods.name: provide_finalize_resources
methods.desc:
Carry shared AVM resources for the following finalization call.
AVM v11 limits the traditional account/application/asset/box arrays to eight entries per application call.  A separate, side-effect-free call in the same atomic group carries ARC-54, the LP asset, and two record boxes so the final call remains within that limit.

methods.name: finalize_launch
methods.desc:
Atomically seed Tinyman, burn 80%, and split remaining LP 50/50.
ARC-54 may already be opted into the LP ASA because its public method accepts donated MBR.  The launch therefore never depends on a duplicate outer opt-in call: the creator funds the app with 100k for its own LP holding plus 100k only when ARC-54 still needs an LP holding, and this method performs the ARC-54 funding/call as a nested atomic group.

methods.name: cancel_created
methods.desc: Return an un-swapped ASA after the recovery delay and free the wallet slot.

methods.name: cancel_launch
methods.desc: Resolve an escrowed launch after the immutable 20,000-round delay.

methods.name: release_cancelled_pnet
methods.desc: Release deferred cancellation PNET only to the hardcoded platform wallet.

methods.name: grant_vestige_access
methods.desc: Grant creator metadata access after completion; safe to retry if unconfirmed.

methods.name: release_platform_allocation
methods.desc: Release only a recorded platform allocation under hardcoded authority.
